name: Licensed guides
description: Approved guide fee per IATO-TGFI rate card (1 Oct 2023 - 30 Sep 2025): half day (up to 4 h) INR 2,050 for 1-5 persons; full day INR 2,500; 6-14 persons INR 2,500 / 3,250; language allowance INR 600 / 800. Per guide, not per person. The agreement period has ended and no newer published card was found, so treat as an estimate. Monument entry is extra. Use only guides showing a Ministry of Tourism / ASI licence card.

name: Audio guides
description: Audio guides are available at Agra Fort (Agra district administration and ASI 'Must See' page). Price not published on any page found.

name: Licensed guides

description: Approved guide fee per IATO-TGFI rate card: a Fatehpur Sikri excursion from Agra is paid as a full day, INR 2,500 for 1-5 persons plus INR 250 conveyance (once per trip). Per guide. Guides engaged at the site may quote differently. Agreement period ended 30 Sep 2025; estimate.

description: Estimated full-meal cost of INR 825 per person. Reported hours: 12 PM to 11:30 PM daily; confirm before visiting.

name: Pinch of Spice - Wazirpura
description: Estimated full-meal cost of INR 800 per person; confirm current prices and hours before visiting.

name: Two-wheeler parking
description: Parking for Taj Mahal visitors is at Shilpgram (East Gate) and Amrood ka Teela (West Gate); polluting vehicles are not allowed within 500 m. No official parking tariff was found, so the previous unsourced estimate (INR 20) was removed.

name: Car or taxi parking
description: Parking for Taj Mahal visitors is at Shilpgram (East Gate) and Amrood ka Teela (West Gate); polluting vehicles are not allowed within 500 m. No official parking tariff was found, so the previous unsourced estimate (INR 100) was removed.

name: Tempo traveller parking
description: Parking for Taj Mahal visitors is at Shilpgram (East Gate) and Amrood ka Teela (West Gate); polluting vehicles are not allowed within 500 m. No official parking tariff was found, so the previous unsourced estimate (INR 225) was removed.

name: Bus parking
description: Parking for Taj Mahal visitors is at Shilpgram (East Gate) and Amrood ka Teela (West Gate); polluting vehicles are not allowed within 500 m. No official parking tariff was found, so the previous unsourced estimate (INR 200) was removed.

name: Battery bus to Taj Mahal gates
location: Shilpgram (East Gate) and Western Gate parking, Taj Mahal, Agra, Uttar Pradesh
description: Free battery buses run from Shilpgram (Eastern Gate) and the Western Gate parking to the monument gates (Agra district administration).

name: Golf cart to Taj Mahal gates
location: Shilpgram (East Gate) and Western Gate parking, Taj Mahal, Agra, Uttar Pradesh
description: Paid golf carts run from the parking areas (Agra district administration); free with SAARC, BIMSTEC and foreign-visitor Taj tickets (UP Tourism). Fare for others not published.

name: Taj Museum
location: Inside the Taj Mahal complex, Agra, Uttar Pradesh
description: Museum inside the Taj Mahal complex, open 10:00-17:00; entry free (Taj ticket required to enter the complex).

name: Cloakroom and ticket windows
location: Eastern and Western Gates, Taj Mahal, Agra, Uttar Pradesh
description: Ticket windows and cloak rooms at both Taj gates; wheelchairs available at the entry gates. Charges, if any, not published.

name: Photography charge
description: Entry to the mosque is free; several travel guides report a camera/phone photography charge of INR 30. Closed to tourists on Fridays. Not confirmed by an official source.

name: Langar (community kitchen)
location: Guru ka Taal Gurudwara, Sikandra, Agra, Uttar Pradesh
description: Free community meals served daily; head covering required (scarves at entrance); footwear deposit available.

name: Cycle rickshaw inside the park
description: Private vehicles are not allowed in the main park; cycle rickshaws (many pullers trained as bird guides) are hired per hour. Reported INR 100-150 per hour; per rickshaw. Not from the Rajasthan Forest Department.

name: Naturalist guide
description: Park guides are hired per hour; reported INR 150-250 per hour. Not from the Rajasthan Forest Department.
